accept: One lesson: the spring clamp, answered by spring and lever. grip as a third sub-function for the jaw tips holding cloth is acceptable.
The two arms are a given, alone or folded into the lesson. The lesson may be the first mechanism with no gap.
catch, ratchet and linkage are bent here.

plan.job: Holds washing on a line until you pinch it open.
uses: Slip it over the washing and the line.

mechanisms.name: Two arms
mechanisms.does: Two arms that meet at the tips around the line.

mechanisms.name: Spring clamp
mechanisms.does: Squeezes the tips shut by itself and opens with a pinch.

gap.try: Hang a wet towel between the two loose arms.
gap.fails: The arms fall apart and the towel drops.

subfunctions.does: Keep the tips squeezed shut with no hand
Open the jaws with a light pinch
